summary: End-to-end re-verification of nested-email fix + saved-RFQ file API + view-only teammate-quote feature. ALL TESTS PASS (5/5 backend pytest, 5/5 frontend Playwright). No live Anthropic parse calls were made.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/email_extract.py: extract_eml() correctly treats message/rfc822 as a leaf in _iter() to avoid Message.walk() bleeding inner-tree content into outer body. Recursion in extract_email_file() is depth-capped (MAX_EMAIL_DEPTH=6) — good guard against mail-bomb loops. No issues found.

routes/parser.py: /api/parser/files/{id}/preview returns 200 for an .eml file with a non-empty payload — verified. Both preview and download endpoints work for the admin's existing saved quote (5d32e0cd-...).

frontend/SpotApp.jsx view-only banner correctly wires Take Over / Copy to context.takeOverActive / copyActive. quote-sections wrapper applies pointer-events:none + opacity:0.55 + aria-disabled='true' when viewOnly — verified via computed style. Banner shows owner display name ('Riley, Ashley') correctly.
frontend/QuoteContext.jsx copyActive() correctly clears viewOnly and creates a NEW draft (toast 'Copied to a new draft (RA-...)') — verified non-destructive of ariley's original record.

Minor (non-blocking): Toolbar.jsx and possibly SpotApp.jsx produce React console warnings: 'Updating a style property during rerender ... mix shorthand and non-shorthand properties for the same value'. Cosmetic, but worth a future cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Frontend STEP 5 (Copy to my drafts) created a new RA-... draft owned by admin (intentional, expected). ariley's original quote a0d5afc6-8e4b-44a6-81b3-0c7ceee1b35d was NOT mutated (Take Over was deliberately avoided per request). No backend cleanup necessary — drafts auto-expire / can be deleted from Load > Drafts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_email_extract_nested.py is reusable for regression. Covers: (1) nested .eml recursion (recursive=True flattens + adds FORWARDED block; recursive=False keeps nested .eml whole) — UNIT, no LLM calls; (2) /api/parser/files list/preview/download for quote 5d32e0cd-... Frontend view-only feature, copy-unlock, and file-preview-modal verified working end-to-end against the live preview URL. The teammate quote id resolved to a0d5afc6-8e4b-44a6-81b3-0c7ceee1b35d.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported fixes verified working. Nested-email extraction in extract_eml() correctly uses a manual _iter() that yields message/rfc822 as a leaf rather than relying on Message.walk(), which is what fixed the original bug of nested .eml content being lost. extract_email_file()'s recursive=True path then flattens the leaf into the parser-bound representation. Preview path uses recursive=False so the UI sees the nested email as a single clickable attachment.
